notes: The IPX-TC1 is a bidirectional IP/AV transceiver (field-configurable as encoder or decoder) sold in two network-interface variants: IPX-TC1-F (10G SFP+ fiber) and IPX-TC1-C (10G copper RJ-45); physical port set is otherwise identical. Desktop/under-table form factor, not natively rack-mountable (no rackUnits set); optional RK2-1-K (1U, holds 2 units) or RK2-5-K (5U, holds 12 units) rack trays are sold separately. Dimensions 6.875 x 4 x 1.31 in (175 x 102 x 33.3mm), weight 2.58 lb. HDMI is rated 1.4 per Aurora's own user manual (distinguishing it from the higher-tier IPX-TC2 model, which is HDMI 2.0); this is consistent with the product page's stated max resolution of 4K2K 4:2:0 @60Hz (within HDMI 1.4's ~10.2Gbps budget). Audio port count varies by source: the manufacturer product page states "3 stereo line in/out (3.5mm TRS)" while the official user manual's rear-panel diagram lists one Audio In and one Audio Out; I've modeled the confirmed manual pair (1 in / 1 out) and flagged the discrepancy here rather than guess at 3 pairs. USB 2.0 Type-A port and Dante audio option both require populating the SO-DIMM expansion slot with an optional card (IPX ExtremeUSB or IPE-DTE-1 Dante card) — the USB port is physically present but nonfunctional without the card. Power input connector is described in Aurora's documentation only as a "48VDC red euro connector" (i.e., a euroblock/terminal-block style DC connector), not a barrel jack; modeled as euroblock-dc. Could not obtain a fully rendered official spec/connector-pinout table (ManualsLib served the surrounding manual text but not the literal front/rear panel diagram graphic), so confidence is medium rather than high. Primary sources used: manufacturer product page (auroramultimedia.com/products/ipxtc1) and Aurora's official IPX-TC1-F/IPX-TC1-C User Manual as indexed/excerpted via ManualsLib (manualslib.com/manual/1382804/Aurora-Ipx-Tc1-F.html, rear-panel and front-panel description pages).

ports.name: SFP+ (10G IPBaseT)
ports.note: IPX-TC1-F fiber variant; single or multi-mode SFP+ module for the 10G IPBaseT link. The IPX-TC1-C copper variant instead uses a 10G RJ-45 port for this link.

ports.name: Audio Out
ports.note: Analog stereo line-level de-embedded audio output

ports.name: RS-232
ports.note: 3.5mm TRS serial pass-through/control, up to 115.2kbps; tip=TX, ring=RX, sleeve=GND

ports.name: IR
ports.note: Bidirectional IR pass-through, 20kHz-60kHz, autosenses TS (emitter) or TRS (receiver) 3.5mm connector

ports.name: USB
ports.note: USB 2.0 Type-A, host or device software-selectable; requires optional ExtremeUSB SO-DIMM expansion card to be populated

ports.name: 48VDC
ports.note: 48V isolated DC power input via 2-pin captive/euroblock terminal connector ("red euro connector"); unit can alternatively be powered via PoE on the 1G LAN port
